title: mailbox brief assertions build their expected paths, and tilde expansion falls back to USERPROFILE
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee herding::mailbox herding::wave
action: Six Windows-only failures. Four in mailbox.rs are test-only: render_brief joins paths with Path::join and renders with display(), which emits backslashes on Windows, while the assertions hard-code forward-slash strings. Build each expected string from the same join(...).display() the production code uses (mailbox_dir and ack_path are already in test scope). Two in wave.rs come from expand_tilde reading only HOME (wave.rs:173): on Windows HOME is normally unset, so a ~/... workspace_trust file never expands - a real production bug. Add a USERPROFILE fallback there, and mirror the same fallback in the test fixture that hard-requires HOME.

truths: Every mailbox assertion derives its expected path from the same join the renderer uses
expand_tilde resolves a home-relative path on a machine where only USERPROFILE is set
No assertion is weakened or cfg-gated away
